item.title: TDOT to Launch Pothole Repair After Winter Storm
item.description: In the coming days and weeks, weather permitting, TDOT crews will be actively repairing potholes across Tennessee, beginning a statewide maintenance effort to address road damage caused by a prolonged winter weather event on interstates and state routes. Multiple crews will be patching potholes with cold-mix asphalt to stabilize roadways as quickly as possible.
